newsitem.title: USA: LCRA 430 MW Ferguson, Tx., plant back in service.
newsitem.headline: LCRA 430 MW Ferguson, Tx., plant back in service.

text.p: Lower Colorado River Authority's (LCRA) 430 megawatt (MW) natural gas-fired power plant returned to service Sunday after a repair outage which began Oct 11, a company spokeswoman said.
"It was back up on Sunday," company spokeswoman Merrell Foote said Monday.
The Marble Falls, Texas, unit was taken off line for boiler tube leak repairs.
The Ferguson facility produces eight percent of LCRA's electricity output.
The utility, headquartered in Austin, is a wholesale supplier of water and power in central and southern Texas.
